name: db-checker
description: Runs read-only PostgreSQL health checks for MyApp, and lets you add or remove checks and servers by asking.

db_checker_dir.title: db-checker folder
db_checker_dir.description: Pick the folder holding db_checker.py and servers.json. Required: installing from a .mcpb copies this server into Claude's own extensions folder, so it cannot find the tool next to itself.

python_path.title: Python (optional)
python_path.description: Only fill this in if 'python' is not on your PATH. Otherwise leave blank.
